data.text:
Last year, I flew 8,000 miles to the Philippines, to have dinner with the person who helped scale my agency to where it is today. For context, Nix has been running my freelance email marketing agency for two years.

We've worked together daily, but I'd never met her in-person.

Sitting around Nix’s dinner table was eye-opening. She lives halfway across the world, but the family dynamics - sitting at her family’s dinner table - felt exactly like home.

Her previous office job required four hours of daily commuting through Manila's brutal traffic. Gone before her family woke up. Home after bedtime.

Now she takes her brother to his weekly treatments and never skips a week.

We talk about cost savings and efficiency all the time. Those metrics matter but there’s a whole other side of hiring overseas that doesn’t get talked about as much:

When you hire overseas talent, you're not just filling a role or cutting costs.

You're giving someone the chance to completely redesign their life around what actually matters to them.

Isn’t that what we all ultimately want?

profile_bio.description: Helping businesses scale with global talent @ Hire Overseas
